title: AnchorRM: Parallel Intra-Batch State Reconstruction with Anchor-Based Residual Memory for Temporal Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.27558v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Memory-based temporal graph neural networks (TGN) rely on recurrent node memories to capture evolving interaction histories. However, temporal mini-batching introduces a trade-off between computational efficiency and temporal fidelity: when a node appears multiple times within the same batch, later interactions are evaluated using stale pre-batch memory because the intermediate memory updates have not yet been committed. This problem becomes more severe as temporal batch size increases. To overcome this challenge, we propose AnchorRM, an anchor-based residual memory mechanism that reconstructs event-specific intra-batch node states without executing sequential recurrent updates. AnchorRM treats the last committed node memory at the beginning of each batch as a pre-batch fixed anchor and uses causally preceding same-batch interactions to infer the missing state evolution relative to that anchor. translated_title: AnchorRM：面向时序图神经网络的基于锚点残差记忆的并行批内状态重建
translated_abstract: 基于记忆的时序图神经网络（TGN）依赖循环节点记忆来捕捉不断演化的交互历史。然而，时序小批量处理在计算效率与时序保真度之间引入了权衡：当同一批次中某个节点出现多次时，后续交互将使用过时的批前记忆进行评估，因为中间的记忆更新尚未被提交。随着时序批次规模的增大，这一问题变得更加严重。为了克服这一挑战，我们提出了AnchorRM，这是一种基于锚点的残差记忆机制，能够在不执行顺序循环更新的情况下重建针对特定事件的批内节点状态。AnchorRM将每个批次开始时最后提交的节点记忆视为批前固定锚点，并利用因果上先于该事件的同批次交互来推断相对于该锚点所缺失的状态演化。学习到的残差随后用于校准……
tldr: 提出AnchorRM机制，将批前最后提交的节点记忆作为固定锚点，通过学习残差来并行重建同批次内各事件的节点状态，从而在不进行顺序循环更新的情况下解决时序图神经网络小批量处理中的状态过时问题。
en_tdlr: AnchorRM introduces an anchor-based residual memory mechanism that treats the last committed node memory as a fixed pre-batch anchor and learns residuals to parallelly reconstruct event-specific intra-batch node states, resolving the stale memory problem in temporal graph neural networks without sequential recurrent updates.
